nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name 'EasterEgg'.
Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token symbol 'EGG'.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' set to 9.
Public uint256 '_totalSupply' holding the initial supply of 20000000000000000000.
Mapping 'balances' from address to token balance; mutated by constructor, transfer and transferFrom without any reentrancy guard.
Nested mapping 'allowed' from owner to spender to allowance; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor that sets name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
Public view totalSupply() returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Public view balanceOf(address) returning balances[tokenOwner].
Public view allowance(address,address) returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve(address,uint) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transfer(address,uint) subtracts from msg.sender and adds to 'to' using SafeMath, emits Transfer.
transferFrom(address,address,uint) moves balances and updates allowance; no explicit allowance sufficiency check beyond SafeMath revert, and no reentrancy guard.
SafeMath helper safeAdd(uint,uint) that computes c = a + b and requires c >= a.
SafeMath helper safeSub(uint,uint) that requires b <= a and computes c = a - b.
SafeMath helper safeMul(uint,uint) that computes c = a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b.
SafeMath helper safeDiv(uint,uint) that requires b > 0 and computes c = a / b.
msg.sender used as the caller identity in constructor, approve, transfer and transferFrom.
balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) inside transfer; arithmetic state update.
balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transfer; arithmetic credit to arbitrary address.
balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) inside transferFrom; debits an arbitrary 'from' address by caller-supplied input.
allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) inside transferFrom; allowance is only implicitly bounded via SafeMath revert.
balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transferFrom; arithmetic credit to arbitrary address.
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul; overflow guarded only by the post-condition require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Addition c = a + b inside safeAdd; overflow guarded by require(c >= a) (Solidity 0.5 unchecked arithmetic).
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub; underflow guarded by require(b <= a) (Solidity 0.5 unchecked arithmetic).
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv; division by zero guarded by require(b > 0).
Parameter 'to' (address) of transfer, credited with tokens.
Parameter 'tokens' (uint) of transfer, amount moved.
Parameter 'from' (address) of transferFrom, debited without an explicit owner check.
Parameter 'to' (address) of transferFrom, credited with tokens.
Parameter 'tokens' (uint) of transferFrom, amount moved and allowance spent.
Parameter 'spender' (address) of approve, key of the allowance mapping.
Parameter 'tokens' (uint) of approve, value written into the allowance mapping.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' (address) of balanceOf, key of the balances mapping.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' (address) of allowance, outer key of the allowed mapping.
Parameter 'spender' (address) of allowance, inner key of the allowed mapping.
Parameter 'a' (uint) of safeAdd, left operand of the addition.
Parameter 'b' (uint) of safeAdd, right operand of the addition.
Parameter 'a' (uint) of safeSub, left operand of the subtraction.
Parameter 'b' (uint) of safeSub, right operand and underflow bound.
Parameter 'a' (uint) of safeMul, left operand of the multiplication.
Parameter 'b' (uint) of safeMul, right operand of the multiplication.
Parameter 'a' (uint) of safeDiv, numerator.
Parameter 'b' (uint) of safeDiv, denominator checked against zero.
Local return variable 'c' of safeAdd holding a + b.
Local return variable 'c' of safeSub holding a - b.
Local return variable 'c' of safeMul holding a * b.
Local return variable 'c' of safeDiv holding a / b.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the token name into the 'name' state variable.
Constructor writes the token symbol into the 'symbol' state variable.
Constructor writes 9 into the 'decimals' state variable.
Constructor sets the initial _totalSupply.
Constructor mints the whole supply into balances[msg.sender].
msg.sender is the minting recipient in the constructor.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using caller identity.
transferFrom uses msg.sender both as allowance spender key and as the spender of another user's funds.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] from the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
allowance reads from the allowed mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer executes the subtraction of balances[msg.sender].
After debiting the sender, transfer credits the recipient balance.
Unsafe operation writes the new sender balance into the balances mapping.
Unsafe operation writes the credited recipient balance into the balances mapping.
transferFrom first debits balances[from] without verifying msg.sender controls 'from'.
Allowance of msg.sender for 'from' is decreased only after the balance debit.
After spending allowance, transferFrom credits the recipient balance.
Unsafe operation writes the debited balance of 'from' into the balances mapping.
Unsafe operation writes the reduced allowance into the allowed mapping.
Unsafe operation writes the credited recipient balance into the balances mapping.
safeAdd performs the unchecked addition c = a + b.
safeSub performs the unchecked subtraction c = a - b.
safeMul performs the unchecked multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv performs the division c = a / b.
The 'to' parameter of transfer is the credited address.
The 'tokens' parameter of transfer is the amount subtracted from the sender.
The 'from' parameter of transferFrom is the debited address, controlled by caller input.
The 'to' parameter of transferFrom is the credited address.
The 'tokens' parameter of transferFrom is deducted from the caller allowance.
The 'spender' parameter of approve becomes the inner key of the allowed mapping.
The 'tokens' parameter of approve is the allowance value written.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter of balanceOf is the lookup key in balances.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter of allowance is the outer key in allowed.
The 'spender' parameter of allowance is the inner key in allowed.
Parameter 'a' of safeAdd is the left operand of the addition.
Parameter 'b' of safeAdd is the right operand of the addition.
Parameter 'a' of safeSub is the left operand of the subtraction.
Parameter 'b' of safeSub is the right operand and the underflow bound.
Parameter 'a' of safeMul is the left operand of the multiplication.
Parameter 'b' of safeMul is the right operand of the multiplication.
Parameter 'a' of safeDiv is the numerator.
Parameter 'b' of safeDiv is the denominator checked against zero.
Local 'c' carries the addition result out of safeAdd.
Local 'c' carries the subtraction result out of safeSub.
Local 'c' carries the multiplication result out of safeMul.
Local 'c' carries the division result out of safeDiv.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter 'to' of transfer is only consumed by the transfer state update and should be folded into the transfer function node.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer is the operand of the safeSub balance update and merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom flows into the balance debit and merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom flows into the recipient credit and merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom is deducted from the caller allowance and merges into that unsafe operation.
Parameter 'spender' of approve is only used by approve and merges into the approve function node.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve is written into the allowance mapping by approve and merges into that function node.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf is only a mapping lookup key and merges into balanceOf.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of allowance is only a mapping lookup key and merges into allowance.
Parameter 'spender' of allowance is only a mapping lookup key and merges into allowance.
Parameter 'a' of safeAdd is operand of the addition and merges into the safeAdd unsafe operation.
Parameter 'b' of safeAdd is operand of the addition and merges into the safeAdd unsafe operation.
Parameter 'a' of safeSub is operand of the subtraction and merges into the safeSub unsafe operation.
Parameter 'b' of safeSub is operand of the subtraction and merges into the safeSub unsafe operation.
Parameter 'a' of safeMul is operand of the multiplication and merges into the safeMul unsafe operation.
Parameter 'b' of safeMul is operand of the multiplication and merges into the safeMul unsafe operation.
Parameter 'a' of safeDiv is the numerator and merges into the safeDiv unsafe operation.
Parameter 'b' of safeDiv is the denominator and merges into the safeDiv unsafe operation.
Local 'c' is the return value of safeAdd and merges into the safeAdd function node.
Local 'c' is the return value of safeSub and merges into the safeSub function node.
Local 'c' is the return value of safeMul and merges into the safeMul function node.
Local 'c' is the return value of safeDiv and merges into the safeDiv function node.
